name: FLOOWBOX - Engagement Rate Tracker and Analyzer

parameters.text:
=Analyze this week's social media performance and extract patterns.

Platform Performance:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.platform_summary) }}

Top Post:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.top_post) }}

Worst Post:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.worst_post) }}

All Posts (last week):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.posts.slice(0,10)) }}

Return JSON:
{
  "overall_performance": "strong/good/average/weak",
  "best_performing_platform": "",
  "what_worked": [],
  "what_flopped": [],
  "top_post_analysis": "",
  "worst_post_analysis": "",
  "content_patterns_to_replicate": [],
  "content_to_avoid": [],
  "next_week_recommendations": [],
  "weekly_summary": "3-4 sentence plain English summary"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Engagement Rate Tracker
Runs every Friday at 5 PM.
Fetches post performance from Google Sheets.
Code node calculates weighted engagement rates:
Likes × 1, Comments × 3, Shares × 5, Saves × 2.
GPT-4o identifies what worked vs what flopped.
Content patterns to replicate + avoid next week.
Saves to Notion + Friday Slack report.

Sheets: Post (Date, Platform, Impressions, Likes, Comments, Shares, Saves, Topic)
